name: cluster
description: Lays its children out in a row that wraps, keeping one gap between them on both axes.

attributes.name: data-gap
attributes.description: Space between items, horizontally and between wrapped rows.

attributes.name: data-align
attributes.description: Vertical alignment of items within a row.

attributes.name: data-justify
attributes.description: How items are distributed along the row.

attributes.name: data-threshold
attributes.description: The cluster's own width below which it is a column of full-width items; at or above it, the wrapping row. Makes the cluster a size container, so it takes the width of its block instead of its content.

children.description: Anything sized by its content: tags, buttons, links, a logo and a nav.

a11y.notes: Purely visual. Use a list element when the items are a list.
